'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu LS Anger, Fear, Aggression''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''Back to Basics'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
